definitions.explanation: The individual stitch or the overall pattern of loops in knitting, crochet, or weaving. Also used more broadly for any mesh or interlocking pattern.

examples.japanese: このセーターは{編|あ}み{目|め}の{模様|もよう}がとてもきれいだ。
examples.english: This sweater has a really pretty knitted pattern.

notes:
Compound of {編|あ}む (to knit, weave) + {目|め} (eye, mesh). Refers both to the individual stitch and to the overall pattern of stitches.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {編|あ}み{目|め}が{細|こま}かい: tight, fine stitches
- {編|あ}み{目|め}が{粗|あら}い: loose, coarse stitches
- {編|あ}み{目|め}をそろえる: to keep the stitches even
- {編|あ}み{目|め}{模様|もよう}: knit pattern
- {編|あ}み{目|め}を{数|かぞ}える: to count the stitches

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {網目|あみめ}: mesh; net pattern — same reading; refers to net or grid patterns, not specifically knitting
- ステッチ: stitch — broader, includes sewing
- {編|あ}み{方|かた}: knitting method — the technique rather than the result
